name: @aibast-agents-library/supply-chain-disruption-alert
sales_headline: Make disruption exposure, route risk, mitigation trade-offs, and supplier candidates reviewable.
card_pitch: Creates a shared synthetic risk and mitigation view while preserving procurement, routing, supplier, and inventory approval gates.
customer_challenge: Supplier, logistics, order, and risk signals are scattered, so impacts surface late and mitigation becomes reactive.
business_value: Creates a shared synthetic risk and mitigation view while preserving procurement, routing, supplier, and inventory approval gates.
why_try: Use the synthetic cases to evaluate routing, evidence quality, and approval boundaries before connecting customer systems.
safety_note: Decision support only; production writes require authenticated tools and explicit authorized human approval.
